membrane_rule0.statement: The measured chains discriminate the mountings: each hypothesis implies testable predictions about where the identified bones sit relative to the scaffold's joint centers.
membrane_rule0.prediction: One mounting predicts the chain geometry (assembly-scale distances between chain-adjacent identified bones' centroids) within tolerance and the other does not.
membrane_rule0.falsifier: For BOTH mountings, the implied assembly-scale distances between chain-adjacent bones' centroids are compared with the walker Table-1 segment lengths (validation/gait_controller_20260918/derived_numbers.json, sha256 013810f87a6ca7c1e01916ef7a5454e61e8d0e88f8d6a589fbfdd1514017a173); the mounting whose chain spans match within 15% wins; if BOTH match or NEITHER does, that is the honest verdict; the recommendation must cite the numbers.

hypotheses.H1_rigid: tools/science_funnel/ct_skeleton_layer.py: the WHOLE skeleton under ONE rigid transform (x_scene = s*(R@x_mm)/1000 + t), s = HAT_length / trunk_PCA_span = 3.23148227 (trunk span 149.158 mm), one rotation, trunk midpoint seated at the free-root height; skull-end residual 2.7 mm on the HAT-pelvis axis (that lane's own measured claim)
hypotheses.H2_per_bone: codex/macaque-bones-lane-20260919 tools/science_funnel/macaque_skeleton_scene.py: bones mounted individually on the stage-E standing scaffold with per-bone joint-span scales (committed: femur pair only, scale = 0.163/joint_span = 3.79-3.81, seated hip->knee; committed falsifiers passed at sub-mm)

gated_falsifier.link_expectation: E(A,B) = 0.5*(L_seg(A)+L_seg(B)) -- mid-bone derivation, stated before measuring; identical for both mountings
gated_falsifier.H2_as_committed: the committed compiler mounts ONLY the femur pair; every (tibia, foot_class) link and every forelimb link has NO implied assembly-scale placement (committed role 'undetermined'), and the femur link's span match is fitted by construction -- recorded, not scored
gated_falsifier.verdict: NEITHER satisfies: the mountings are both wrong on the measured chains (pre-registered falsifier 2 applies -- this is the honest verdict, not a failure to decide)

pose_free_discriminator.why: a bone's own cap-to-cap joint span under each mounting's scale vs its Table-1 segment -- the curled pose cannot affect this test
pose_free_discriminator.H2: exact by construction (scale = segment/joint_span; fitted, not a prediction)

scale_conflict.note: the trunk-anchored and limb-anchored scales disagree about the assembly scale itself, beyond the 15% tolerance

post_hoc_attribution_not_gated.derivation: committed scaffold angles (phi_thigh 18.83, phi_shank -30.79, foot_pitch 15.75 deg) + Table-1 mid-span centroids; derived from the same pinned numbers, labeled POST-HOC -- it attributes failures, it does not replace the gated test
post_hoc_attribution_not_gated.H1: knee links stay -68.4%/-72.7% even flexion-aware: the failure is the measured curled pose (CT centroid spacing 15.3/13.2 mm) plus the scale -- no rigid transform can fix it
post_hoc_attribution_not_gated.H2_generalized: matches EVERY gated link within ~5% flexion-aware (-4.0%/+4.7%/+3.9%/-2.9%/-0.7%): the gated foot failures are the straight-chain expectation meeting the scaffold's ~105-deg foot pitch, an artifact of the expectation model, identical for both mountings

orientation_finding.finding: the committed H2 orientation (raw PCA sign in femur_landmarks) is unvalidated by that lane's own falsifiers (seating is 0 by construction either way; the surface bound passes on any bone end), and trunk proximity is invalid in a curled specimen
orientation_finding.resolution: H2-generalized mounts with chain-adjacency orientation -- the cap nearer the touching chain partner is the shared-joint cap, from the arbiter's own touching_edges; all mounted bones resolved with margins 1.11-9.05 mm
orientation_finding.curl_evidence: foot bones touch tibiae on the knee side (e.g. edges 3-17, 7-18): the curled pose folds the feet against the femur side; distal touches recorded as curl observations, not orientation votes
orientation_finding.effect: with the corrected orientation the H2 knee link (3,7) improved from -11.9% to -5.7%

reported_not_gated.forelimb: Table-1 folds the forelimbs into HAT: no arm segment expectation exists. H1 implied humerus->forearm centroid distances 0.0752-0.0866 m; H2 leaves forelimb bones unmounted -- forelimb chains cannot gate either mounting
reported_not_gated.curl_contacts: femur-foot (2-15, 3-17) and humerus-hand (4-8, 5-9) touches are curl folds, not articulations; fibula and forearm pairs are parallel elements within one segment

verdict: NEITHER mounting satisfies the pre-registered chain falsifier on every gated link -- the honest verdict per falsifier (2). The chains still DISCRIMINATE: H1 fails everything (all 5 gated links -29% to -75%; 3 of 4 pose-free bone spans -15% to -27%), with the failure in the measured curled pose and the trunk-anchored scale; H2-generalized passes the femur->tibia links (-12.8%/-5.7%) and its gated foot failures (-27% to -33%) are expectation-model artifacts, vanishing to within ~5% against the flexion-aware standing skeleton.

recommendation.mounting_for_the_final_visual: H2 per-bone scaffold mounting, generalized to the identified tibiae (and tibia-touching foot bones), chain-adjacency orientation
recommendation.why_the_numbers_say_so: H2 is the only mounting whose implied chain geometry is consistent with the walker skeleton: femur->tibia -12.8%/-5.7% (PASS the 15% gate) and every link within ~5% of the flexion-aware standing skeleton, while H1 lands at -29% to -75% on every link and makes the limb bones themselves 15-27% too short at its 3.2315 scale
honest_caveats: H2's span agreement is FITTED (scale = segment/joint_span), not predicted; the measured content is the centroid geometry and the committed sub-mm femur seating falsifiers
the committed H2 compiler covers only the femur pair; using it for the final visual requires the generalized per-bone rule measured here (tibia scales 4.40-4.42, foot 6.25-8.82)
the committed PCA orientation was replaced by measured chain-adjacency orientation (documented above)
recommendation.H1_retained_for: its own measured claim only: the trunk-aligned whole-CT layer (skull-end residual 2.7 mm on the HAT-pelvis axis, pin sha256 013810f87a6ca7c1e01916ef7a5454e61e8d0e88f8d6a589fbfdd1514017a173); it must NOT be used to present limb chains
